### Fixed
- **`muster list resource` keeps muster's own `auth://status`, and `muster list prompt -o wide` counts an aggregated prompt's arguments.** Listing through `list_resources` dropped the resources only the native listing carries, muster's own `auth://status` among them; they are listed again, without a server. The wide ARGS column showed `-` for every aggregated prompt, which the native listing does not carry; the wide listing now reads their arguments with `describe_prompt`. ([#1252](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1252))
